# Extract Peter Jackson movie titles from Simple Note 'Movie Recommendations' note 2705
import re
sn_token=apis.simple_note.login(username='pa_ritter@gmail.com', password='F%rYCAJ')['access_token']
note=apis.simple_note.show_note(note_id=2705, access_token=sn_token)
content=note['content']

# Parse entries: title lines then ' - director: ...' next line(s)
lines=content.splitlines()
entries=[]
current_title=None
for line in lines:
    line_stripped=line.strip()
    if not line_stripped or line_stripped.startswith('#'):
        continue
    # Title lines have no leading '-'
    if not line_stripped.startswith('-'):
        current_title=line_stripped
    else:
        # director line
        m=re.match(r"-\s*director:\s*(.*)", line_stripped)
        if m and current_title:
            director=m.group(1).strip()
            entries.append((current_title,director))

# Filter for exact/direct match to 'Peter Jackson'
peter_titles=[title for (title,director) in entries if director=='Peter Jackson']
# Preserve order, no forced dedupe unless duplicates exist from parsing
peter_titles_unique=list(dict.fromkeys(peter_titles))
print('peter_titles',peter_titles)
print('peter_titles_unique',peter_titles_unique)

# Compose comma-separated movie titles
message=', '.join(peter_titles_unique)
print('message:',message)

# Send to Leslie from last messages (Leslie Ball phone number 7873383923)
phone_token=apis.phone.login(username='2444880289', password='Xm4bukk')['access_token']
resp=apis.phone.send_text_message(phone_number='7873383923', message=message, access_token=phone_token)
print('send_response',resp)
